result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues: category chips and restaurant cards overflow, a restaurant name is truncated, and delivery time text overlaps on a popular listing.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is clipped on the right, cutting off the name 'Trattoria Piccol'.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal carousel enough padding or peek so the last visible card (or its title) is not cut off.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, delivery time text is garbled/overlapping as '25-30elivery' instead of a clear time and delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata layout so time and delivery info do not collide and display as something like '25–30 min · delivery'.

issues.description: The category filter chips overflow the screen; 'Healthy' is cut off and the next chip is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding or fade and allow full horizontal scroll so chips are not clipped at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is cropped by the tab bar, so most of the restaurant details below the image are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure list content has enough bottom inset above the tab bar so cards are not hidden.
